༄༅/ /brtan bzhugs kyi rim pa rnams bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// brtan bzhugs kyi rim pa rnams bzhugs so//

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i mthu rtsal bcas// sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin spel byed pa yi// sangs rgyas rin chen yar gyi ngo bzhin du// sku tshe brtan cing phrin las rgyas gyur cig /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// 'gro don mdzad phyir zhabs pad brtan pa dang*| |nyid kyi sku tshe srid mthar brtan gyur cig /khyed kyi sku tshe zhing khams gdul bya rnams// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i don du skur sprul pa// gang gi zhabs pad sangs rgyas rin chen nyid// bskal pa'i bar du 'gro don mdzad phyir bzhugs// 'gro ba ma lus sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces gding pa bla ma'i dbus yang ri'i dge 'dun mang ba zhig gi ngor/ 'brug lo zla ba drug pa'i yar tshes bcu gcig gi nyin gza' skar 'dzoms pa dang bstun te phul/// / ༈ /mkhan chen rnam 'joms phun tshogs kyi brtan bzhugs/ chos sku kun bzang longs sku thugs rje can// sprul sku pad 'byung bslu med dkon mchog gsum// mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi mthu stobs kyis// rnam 'joms phun tshogs sku tshe brtan gyur cig /srid zhi'i dpal gyur 'gro ba'i mgon khyod ni// sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin spel byed pa dang*// khams gsum sems can bde la 'god mdzad phyir// bskal pa'i bar du zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs| /'chi bdag la sogs bdud bzhi 'joms pa dang*// thugs rjes bdag sogs 'gro la brtser dgongs nas// khyod nyid srid mtha'i bar du bzhugs su gsol// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las mgon// nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// bi da la sogs bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams// sku tshe brtan cing phrin las rgyas gyur cig /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// bdag sogs rnams kyis smon lam btab pa'i mthus// sangs rgyas bstan pa yar gyi ngo bzhin du// bstan 'dzin skyes bu khyed kyis spel bar shog// /

༈ /mtshungs med dam pa bkra shis phun tshogs grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i brtan bzhugs/ bkra shis lha yi gdung las rab 'khrungs shing*// phun sum tshogs pa du mar mnga' brnyes pa| |grags pa rgyal mtshan 'gro ba'i mgon po mchog /sku tshe brtan cing phrin las rgyas gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang mkhan po dbon pos bskul ba las/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas rang lo bcu'i steng du phul/// / ༈ /zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa drug pa dpal rdo rje gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje dga' ba don grub phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i khyab bdag bstan pa'i nyi ma chos kyi snang ba zhes pa'i drung du khri phrag stong du bzhugs pa'i brtan bzhugs su phul ba/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgyal sras thams cad dang*// rje btsun bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bslu med skyabs mchog rnams kyi mthu dag gis// 'dren pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan zhabs brtan gsol// rgyal kun mkhyen brtse ma lus gcig bsdus pa// snyigs dus 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mgon po mchog /rig 'dzin pad+ma rim dgu'i lha tshogs mthus// 'gro ba'i mgon 'di bskal par zhabs brtan gsol// bde chen mchog gyur 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku// tshangs dbyangs sgra yis chos ston rdo rje'i gsung*// mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag sgrib bral rdo rje'i thugs// sku lnga'i dkyil 'khor mtshan dpe'i yon tan ldan// ye shes lnga ldan rig gnas bye ba'i mdzod// dus gsum gsal bar mkhyen pa gang gi sku// khri phrag du mar khyod zhabs brtan par gsol// rgyal ba sku dngos khyab bdag bde ba che// phyogs dus bla ma yi dam kun 'dus pa// skye 'chi'i 'ching bral gzhom med rdo rje'i sku// ji srid bskal pa'i bar du bzhugs su gsol// thugs rjes kun gsal 'gro ba ma lus 'dren// mdo sngags sde snod kun gyi mgon po mchog /rtag chad 'pho 'gyur dang bral gzhom pa med// srid mtha'i bar du zhabs pad brtan par gsol// ston pa nyid dang gu rus lung bstan pa// dus ngan snyigs ma'i 'gro la brtser dgongs nas// cod pan 'dzin pa rim par byon pa las// drug pa gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug nyid// zhing 'dir srid mtha'i bar du bzhugs su gsol// bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi bden stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi mthu dang nus pa yis// bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i bla ma mchog

/bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs su gsol// rje btsun bla ma 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// gangs can mkhas dang grub pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog |sku tshe phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas nas// 'gro ba ma lus rdzogs ldan dus bzhin shog /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i dga' ster zhing*// chos sku chen pos rang don mthar phyin nas// gzugs skus zhing mang gdul bya smin byed shog /ces khri stong du bzhugs pa'i gsol 'debs su zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa chen po drug pa dpal gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gi drung du/ dkon mchog phun tshogs rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ sa sprel zla ba dang po gsar pa'i dge mtshan dang bcas rang lo bcu gsum gyi thog tu/ zan yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i sa'i cha sa phug theg mchog rtser sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ /sngon bsags bsod nams tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs shing*// phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las pa| |rigs ldan cho 'brang mngon mtho'i dpal mnga' ba'i// 'gro ba'i mgon khyod bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// rgyal ba'i bstan rtsa chos 'dul chen po ni// ngo mtshar gnang bkag spang blang rang bzhin te// sum ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dge sbyong che// mi 'jigs 'khor lo bskor phyir zhabs brtan gsol// thub pa'i gsung rab mtha' bral rgya mtsho'i klong*// brjod bya'i tshig don kun nas 'doms pa las// thos bsam sgom pas 'gro rnams smin mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon khyod ni zhabs brtan gsol// lam srol ma log gnyug ma'i ye shes 'di| |rang ngo shes pa'i skal ldan gdul bya rnams// 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral phyir mnyan pa mchog /skyabs mchog khyod ni srid mthar zhabs brtan gsol// bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dang*// bden tshig grub pa rnams kyi mthu stobs dang*// 'gro ba'i re skong rgyal mchog gang khyod ni// bskal brgyar zhabs pad mi g.yo brtan gyur cig

/de las byung ba'i dge ba dri med des// bshad dang sgrub pa'i lam srol la brten nas// sangs rgyas bstan mchog yun ring gnas pa dang*// 'gro rnams rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces pa 'di 'jang gi dbon po slob dpon gyis bskul ba las/ dpal ri bo che pa'i chos rje rin po che'i brtan bzhugs su/ shākya'i dge slong chos smra ba dharma kīrtis sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ /bskal mang gong nas tshogs rab rdzogs pa'i mthus// grub dbang pad+mas rjes bzung lung bstan pa// zab gter bdag po pad gling sprul pa'i sku// 'gro la sman slad bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// tshul khrims bag yod mang thos brtul zhugs 'chang*| |rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso// lha sngags 'khor lo'i dbang phyug bla ma mchog /nam mkha' ji bzhin 'tsho zhing gzhes gyur cig /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// rtsa gsum dam can srung ma'i mthu rtsal phul// bdag gi mos blo lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus// 'dren pa mchog khyod zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /ces pa'ang rtsa ba'i bla ma gsum sprul tshul khrims rdo rje'i brtan bzhugs su/ bla ma byang gling pa dang dbu mdzad rdor grags sogs grwa 'bangs rnams kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas rtse ba gzhis kar mgyogs par sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi snying khar pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs la// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// lhun grub chos dbyings spros bral klong 'byams las// sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i zlos gar mkhan// gang 'dul der ston chu zla ji bzhin du// dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// dkon mchog rnam gsum rtag pa'i ngo bo nyid// phrin las mi zad phyogs kyi 'khor lo kun// bzang por 'gengs pa'i dam chos dga' ston 'gyed// dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// rnam dag tshul khrims nor gyis rtag phyug cing*// gzhan don byang chub thugs kyis 'gro kun srung*// theg mchog sngags kyi gsang ba kun rdzogs pa// dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// ston pa 'jig rten sogs brjod/
ces pa'ang mtshungs med dkon mchog rin chen gyi sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog phrin las bzang po'i brtan bzhugs kyi thog mar 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
